name: Music Discovery
primary_user_goal: Find new music that matches personal taste and mood
business_goal: Increase catalog exploration, listening time, and platform stickiness through personalization
entry_point: Home screen or personalized playlist notification
exit_point: User playing discovered content or saving to library

name: Search and Find
primary_user_goal: Locate specific song, artist, album, or playlist
business_goal: Minimize friction between intent and playback to maximize listening sessions
exit_point: User plays or saves found content

name: Content Browsing
primary_user_goal: Explore albums, playlists, or artist catalogs in depth
business_goal: Drive saves, follows, and complete album/playlist listens
entry_point: Tapping album, playlist, or artist from any screen
exit_point: User plays content, saves to library, or follows artist

name: Active Listening
primary_user_goal: Control playback, view current track, and manage queue
business_goal: Maximize listening session duration and encourage track saves
entry_point: Tapping mini player or starting playback
exit_point: User pauses or ends listening session

name: Library Management
primary_user_goal: Access and organize saved music, playlists, and podcasts
business_goal: Encourage library building to increase switching costs and return visits
exit_point: User plays saved content or creates/edits playlist
